transformations: Changed float scalars and suffixed constants to double; sqrtf/floorf/powf/roundf to their double equivalents.
Preserved original scene arrays, intersection/shading operation order, recursive reflections through depth five, and round-then-wrap RGB quantization.
Replaced tile/text rendering harness with standalone POSIX main and compile-time IMAGE_SIZE, REPETITIONS, CLOCK_ID, EMIT_PIXELS configuration.
Moved camera setup/allocation and final protocol/RGB output outside timing; timed each full RGB render plus checksum, publishing each frame checksum through a volatile scalar sink.
